node.statement: Resolution of the scope challenge. Let H be the assertion that c_0^cb is a fixed finite nonnegative universal constant. By node 1.1.2, H is not provided by the registered definitions or any of the six permitted externals; by node 1.6.1.2, all threshold bounds needed for the raw-call datum are available only under H; and by nodes 1.6.2 and 1.6.2.1, raw refinement therefore yields only H implies the certified output and cannot yield the unconditional root. Consequently the former final sentence of node 1.6 was invalid. The amended node 1.6 makes exactly the conditional conclusion and explicitly records that the unconditional root remains unproved, so it neither drops H nor overstates the allowed inputs.
